stem: A cultivar repeatedly splits at a specific branch angle during support work. Which response is most defensible?
choices: Reduce mechanical stress and revise the cultivar-specific execution criteria while preserving the production objective
Increase force until the branch angle matches other cultivars
Remove all support from every cultivar
Treat the splitting as proof of disease
rationale: Repeated cultivar-specific injury is evidence that the execution method should be adapted rather than forced uniformly.
